title: Bindu Rakanyangarika Usiku Hwese
intro: Fungidzira bindu rakasvibira, rine michero yakaibva uye rakakomberedzwa nemiti mirefu. Avo vairiritira vaifunga kuti vakangwara, vachironga kukohwa kwavo munguva dzakanyarara mambakwedza asati asvika, kure nemaziso evanoshaya. Asi Uyo asingamborari aiva nedzimwe hurongwa hwepfuma yavo yakavanzwa. Ungafungidzira here kuti ndiani ari shure kwenyaya iyi yekunyevera kubva muKorani?
clues: Taimbova nebindu rine miti yakawanda zvekuti rakazove godo revanhu vese vaipfuura napo.
Mukuronga kwedu, takataurirana nekazevezeve mangwanani-ngwanani, tichizivisa kuti hapana mweya unoshayiwa waizobvumirwa kupinda pazuva iroro.
Taiva vanhu vane pfuma, uye mwoyo yedu yakanga yatopofumadzwa kukodzero dzevarombo vakatipoteredza.
Pakasvika mambakwedza ekukohwa kwataida, takasvika pedyo nebindu redu ndokuwana rashanduka kuita matongo usiku hwose.
Murairo unoparadza wakauya, usingasiyi chinhu kunze kwemadota apo paimbova nemasumbu emichero yakaibva.
Nyaya yedu inyevero yakasimba yakanyorwa muKorani, uko tinozivikanwa sevaridzi vebindu vakanyima rubatsiro kune vanoshaya.
